Definition
[Almost hyperbolic cusp region] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0266, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0267 1. ch33:33.31\group Cusp comparison

For $0<B<A<\widetilde A$, the almost hyperbolic cusp region $\mathcal C_{A,B}(t)$ is the region bounded by a chosen component $T_A(t)\subset \partial \mathcal M_A(t)$ and the corresponding component of $\partial \mathcal M_B(t)$. Its parallel tori are denoted $T_{A,\rho }(t)=\{ d_{g(t)}(\, cdot\, ,T_A(t))=\rho \} $.
